_about: Known plugin problems, keyed on product + identified version (from known_plugins.json hashes). 'when' conditions: 'installed' = another product is installed.

issues.title: Official Skyline has the page-boundary bug
issues.detail: With Smashline installed, the official subsdk9 crashes at Skyline + 0x4c58 on game 13.0.5.
issues.fix: Use the patched subsdk9 (4-byte patch check).

issues.title: Smashline 1.6.7 is an early 13.0.5 build
issues.detail: 1.6.8 is the last release with the old moveset API and has fixes over 1.6.7.

unknownBuildAdvice.Smashline: Only Smashline 1.6.7+ supports game 13.0.5. An unrecognised build may be older; get 1.6.8 or 2.0.0 from the official releases.
unknownBuildAdvice.The CSK Collection: CSK versions before 6.0.0 don't support game 13.0.5.
unknownBuildAdvice.One Slot Effects: The '(OUTDATED)' One Slot Effects page stops at 13.0.2; use the 13.0.5 build (GameBanana 549058).
unknownBuildAdvice.Stage Config: Stage Config before 1.1.1 doesn't support game 13.0.5.
